children: Palantir Technologies CEO Alex Karp said frontier AI labs, including Anthropic, are using safety concerns to push for nationalization and liability protection from lawsuits over model harm. According to BeInCrypto, Karp made the remarks on CNBC’s “Squawk on the Street,” arguing civil and criminal liability would be a stronger check than voluntary safety pledges.
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation and recently raised $65 billion in a private round at a valuation near $965 billion before confidentially filing for a planned public listing.

title: Palantir CEO Karp Says Anthropic Wants AI Nationalization To Dodge Lawsuits
